meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会扫描Azure Functions和App Service资源，检查可用区冗余、ZRS存储、健康探测和多区域故障转移，生成按功能分组的可靠性检查表，并在用户确认后通过CLI或IaC补丁分阶段修复问题。
howto.when: 当用户要求评估或检查可靠性，提到“区域冗余”、“高可用性”、“多区域故障转移”等关键词，或要求查找单点故障时触发。只适用于Azure Functions和App Service。

say.text: 评估我的Function App的可靠性
say.note: 触发扫描并生成检查表

say.text: 我的App Service是区域冗余的吗？
say.note: 检查计算资源的可用区配置

say.text: 为我的应用启用多区域故障转移
say.note: 先评估，再询问是否配置

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans Azure Functions and App Service resources, checks zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. It presents a feature-based reliability checklist, then drives staged remediation via CLI or IaC patches with user confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to assess or check reliability, mentions keywords like "zone redundant", "high availability", "multi-region failover", or wants to find single points of failure. Only covers Azure Functions and App Service.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my Function App.
say_en.note: Triggers a scan and generates a checklist.

say_en.text: Is my App Service zone redundant?
say_en.note: Checks zone redundancy configuration on compute.

say_en.text: Set up multi-region failover for my app.
say_en.note: Assesses first, then asks before configuring.
